bio.text: Lori Hickman is the Democratic candidate for Idaho Attorney General in 2026, running against Republican incumbent Raúl Labrador; she has not previously run for public office.
She is an Idaho attorney whose experience includes working for Micron and clerking at the U.S. District Court for the District of Idaho.

She grew up in Boise, graduated from the J. Reuben Clark Law School at Brigham Young University, and practiced law in New York City and Salt Lake City before returning to Idaho as in-house counsel for Micron Technology.

sources.title: In race for Idaho attorney general, a Democrat is trying to unseat a long-time Republican official
Democratic candidate for Idaho AG promises professionalism over politics
